data.name: Retrieve Store Status
data.description: The Get Store Status endpoint retrieves the orderability status of a location.
data.evaluateGuide:
Checks whether a specified Uber Eats location is currently orderable. Agents can determine store availability before offering delivery options.
Use for: check store orderability, verify location availability, gate ordering flows
Not supported: placing orders, menu retrieval, delivery tracking

data.name: Lookup Orders
data.description:
Allows you to view the following information for a specific order:

'regEDisclosure' - RegE Disclosure information (if applicable)
'payments' - beneficiary details
'settlements' - settlement details
'orderDetails' - rates, amounts, trade details, etc.

Note: If the order is subject to the Regulation E remittance transfer rule as required by the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act (commonly referred to as Dodd-Frank), and the order includes at least one p
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves detailed information for a specific cross-border payment order, including disclosures, beneficiary payments, settlements, and trade details when available.
Use for: inspect order details, view payment information, review settlements, check disclosures
Not supported: creating orders, updating orders, initiating transfers

data.name: Order v2 - Get Detail
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves detail for an order through the Withings health integration. Agents can obtain order-specific information using the v2 order resource.
Use for: get order detail, inspect an order, retrieve order information
Not supported: order creation, order updates, shipment tracking

data.name: SearchOrders (fulfillment_filter)
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches Square orders using supplied search criteria, including fulfillment filtering. Agents can find matching orders for operational or fulfillment workflows.
Use for: search orders, filter by fulfillment, find matching orders
Not supported: creating orders, updating orders, processing payments

data.name: Order Statuses
data.description:
Recupera gli stati degli ordini.
Gli stati non sono altro che cartelle in cui gli ordini possono essere 
inseriti. Un ordine deve necessariamente stare in uno stato.
MarketRock contiene 4 stati predefiniti:

Acquistato: lo stato in cui vengono creati tutti gli ordini nuovi
Ricevuto
Spedito: quando un ordine viene spostato in questo stato, viene segnalata la spedizione al marketplace da cui l'ordine proviene.
Chiuso

Segnaliamo che "Pagato" non è uno stato su Ma
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves all order statuses configured in MarketRock, including predefined lifecycle states. Agents can use them to interpret or organize order progress.
Use for: list order statuses, inspect lifecycle states, map order folders
Not supported: retrieving orders, changing statuses, managing shipments

data.name: Get Order
data.description:
Retrieve a single product by its ID. All of its SKUs will also be
retrieved.
Required scope | ecommerce:read
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a single Webflow order by site and order ID, including its associated SKUs. Agents can inspect an individual ecommerce order.
Use for: get an order, inspect order SKUs, retrieve ecommerce details
Not supported: listing orders, creating orders, updating orders

data.name: /store/orders/{{order_id}}
data.description: Get information on a specified order.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves information about a specified order from OneProvider. Agents can inspect an order using its identifier.
Use for: get an order, inspect order details, retrieve order information
Not supported: creating orders, updating orders, listing orders

data.name: Retrieve an order
data.description: Retrieves an existing order using an object ID.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves an existing Shippo order by its object ID. Agents can inspect order data associated with a shipment workflow.
Use for: get an order, inspect order data, retrieve shipping order details
Not supported: creating orders, updating orders, tracking shipments

meta.q: look up an order and its shipping status in an e-commerce store
